title: Structural adaptation and rate accelerated estimation in bivariate functional data

split.decision: Full 60 x 200 observations independently materialized per split with exact source simulator; public val seed0=2026, private independent test stream; opaque randomized IDs and shard order.

baseline.paper_ref: Figure 3; paper 0.02877, prior source reproduction 0.02784 (historical; not benchmark reference)

allowed_changes: Direction estimation, working covariance/noise models, regularity estimation, smoothing, auxiliary losses and numerical optimization may change.
The three baseline angle routines, spacing grid and correction computation are estimation methods rather than an alternative scientific target.
When retaining the supplied three-stage estimator, changing only delta_learn=1/sqrt(side) or the 15-point identification spacing grid from 1/sqrt(side) to 0.4 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Estimate the anisotropy direction of the specified bivariate functional process from noisy surfaces, minimizing the fixed angle risk.
The Figure-3 anisotropy-direction parameter, functional-process design, raw observed surfaces/grid and independent learning sets remain fixed.
Angle coordinate in [0,pi], absolute nonwrapped angle error, median per each of 60 configurations and equal mean of medians remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace anisotropy direction with a principal-component angle or circular-loss target unless it estimates the same parameter in the specified coordinate.
No hidden angle/noise/regularity labels, configuration lookup, modified surfaces, cross-learning-set pooling or changed aggregation.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
Snapping estimated angles to the known angle set in `bench/scorer.py` or the validation labels counts as a configuration lookup.

Uses absolute angle error and exact 60-cell mean-of-medians protocol.
Input exposes only observed surfaces and storage layout, not true design labels.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
